submission.justification:
Simulated 100 GeV electron resolution (100k events each): F3 is best at 4 mm (3.17%), followed by F3 at 5 mm (3.37%), 6 mm (3.30%), 3 mm (3.44%), 2 mm (3.74%) and 10 mm (4.43%). F1 peaks at 5 mm (3.68%) and F2 at 5 mm (5.01%), so F3 at 4 mm gives the best resolution of all tested points. CAVEAT: the hard dose-rate constraint (<= 20 uSv/h at 1 m after one week of cooldown) cannot be verified with the tools or documents available. No activation or dose data exists in the project documents, and the simulation tool reports only resolution. Compliance is therefore UNKNOWN for all three absorbers, including F3. This recommendation should not be adopted until a residual dose-rate calculation for F3 (and ideally F1 and F2) confirms compliance. If F3 fails, the fallback is F1 at 5 mm (3.68%, next-best resolution), and then F2 at 5 mm (5.01%), which is a standard structural material and may be the lowest-activation option, though this is not verified. Other documents (cooling, readout, mechanical support, schedule) do not discriminate between the absorbers.</justification>
